Deep clean:
How this app works. Press down to read, up to come back.

WHAT XCPE IS
XCPE is a backdoor built into the firmware of many cheap Android TV boxes (MECOOL, Videostrong and boxes sold under other names). It lets strangers run things on your box: fake ad clicks, hidden traffic through your internet connection, and whatever else they send it.

WHAT SCAN DOES
Scan looks at the apps on this box, at Google Play Protect and at the Accessibility settings, and compares them with the published list of XCPE parts. It changes nothing and sends nothing anywhere.

WHAT REMOVE THREATS DOES
It removes the XCPE apps for this box and switches Google Play Protect back on. If an app cannot be removed, it is switched off so it cannot run. The app first tries to do this by itself; this works when the box's debugging door is open (Developer options). Otherwise it opens the right settings pages for you and tells you which button to press.

WHAT STAYS
Many boxes keep a spare copy of the backdoor in a read-only part of the firmware. The app cannot delete that copy without root access, but the copy cannot run while the app is removed or switched off. If XCPE comes back after a restart, this app notices and removes it again, and tells you.

OUR HONEST ADVICE
A box that shipped with a backdoor was never yours alone. If you can, replace it with a box from a known brand (Google TV Streamer, Apple TV, Fire TV, Nvidia Shield). If you keep it, do not log in to banking or email on it.

CHANGE YOUR PASSWORDS
If you ever typed a password on this box, change it from another device: Google account, Netflix, Wi-Fi and anything else you used here.

AFTER CLEANING
Restart the box, open this app and press Scan once more. The app also checks by itself after every restart and shows the result under 'Last check'.
